data.name: Vallarasu
data.long_meaning: Lord Vallarasu is the God of Wisdom, Knowledge and Wealth. He is believed to bestow the blessings of wisdom and knowledge upon his devotees. He is also known as the protector of the Vedas and the God of learning.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the wisdom and knowledge that comes with spiritual growth and enlightenment.

The God Vallarasu is often invoked during academic and intellectual pursuits, as He is believed to be the divine patron of education and learning. The name is deeply rooted in the Indian tradition of valuing knowledge and wisdom above all else.

He embodies the idea that knowledge is a sacred gift, and that the acquisition of knowledge is a spiritual journey. The name Vallarasu serves as a reminder that knowledge and wisdom are not just tools for material success, but are essential for spiritual growth and enlightenment. By invoking the name Vallarasu, one can tap into the divine energy that fosters the growth of knowledge, wisdom and spiritual understanding within oneself.
